model_annotations.Chinese: This line chart illustrates three different pieces of information as a function of the number of layers using a cosinus transformation with a rate of 0.3 and a period of 2π/25. The x-axis ranges from 0 to 20 layers. The y-axis represents the absolute mean, with the first line showing fluctuations around 0 to just above 1, displaying a relatively stagnant trend within this range. The second line remains consistently at a lower value, approximately 0.05, across all layers. The third line starts near 0, rises slightly, then remains steady near 0.07 for most of the graph before ending with a small upward trend at layer 20, nearing the value of 0.08.
model_annotations.English: The line plot illustrates the trend of the Abs Mean as a function of the Layer number. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and it represents the Layer number, which ranges from 0 to 20, likely representing the progression of layers in a system or phenomenon being analyzed. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and it measures the magnitude of the absorption, with no unit provided, suggesting that it could be a dimensionless measurement or related to a specific scale. There are three lines in the plot, each with different line styles: the blue dashed line represents the average of the "hidden state mean before gate", the orange dotted line represents the average of the "hidden state mean after gate", and the green solid line represents the "hidden state mean of baseline". The values at the start of the x-axis are 0.71 for the blue line, 0.05 for the orange line, and 0.04 for the green line. As the layer number increases, the blue line increases with some fluctuations, the orange line decreases consistently, and the green line remains relatively flat with a slight upward trend. The blue line shows a peak around the Layer value of 10, after which it declines and then rises again towards Layer 20. The orange and green lines remain relatively stable, with the green line showing a gradual increase towards the end of the plot.
model_annotations.German:
Das Diagramm ist ein lineares Diagramm, das die Abweichung von der absoluten Mean-Baseline im hidden state mean im Hidden State UMAP-Representation bei Wetterfaktoren vor, nach Gate 0 und beim wasserklären stellt. Die x-Achse repräsentiert die layer (Echelon), wobei die Werte signifikante Änderungen oder 'Gate' anzeigen. Es beginnt bei layer 0, schneidet wahrscheinlich Anfang layer 4 oder 5, bleibt eher konstant zwischen layer 10 und 16 und schneidet Schlüsselpunkte bei layer 18, 19 und 20.

Die y-Achse stellt die Abweichung von der absoluten Basisline, also von 0, dar. Sie beginnt bei null und was Houston sicherlich planète 4. Da der diagramm ein lineares Werk angeht und über die x-Achse 18, 19 und 20 Schlüsselpunkte hat, können genaue Datenpunkte nicht angegeben werden. Die Linien sind in drei Farben, wobei jeder Linienstil [thin, line], [medium, dashed] und [thick, solid] ist. Abweichungen umfassen das Layer in Relativität, bei einigen Schlüsselpunkten erhöht/erklärt/zwangsbedingt durch das Gate.

Antwort: hidden (grundstück) hidden states concealed hidden states
